lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.criterion: Feedback/recovery (2/4): distinguish an unknown save outcome from a confirmed failure
findings.observation: Confirmed visible defect. In the English light contact-save response-loss state, the card says both “Previous outcome is unknown” and “The contact was not saved. Your proposal is still here.” The frozen catch branch supplies the latter fallback after a request whose outcome is already protected as pending. This is a false failure assertion, not evidence of duplicate writes or premature success.
findings.evidence: Frozen GET-5-product-v1 at /tmp/get5-product-review-v1: evidence/screenshots/07-contact-response-lost-r6.png, lower card beneath the identity clue and Identity check; source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipAskView.swift:5049-5053 and :5670-5694. Reproduction: submit synthetic Mina Patel contact, confirm, drop the response after commit. source/apps/ios/UITests/CandidateSignalUITests.swift:5031-5035; evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r6.log:271-282 captures the error state. Surface: supplied 1206×2622 portrait Simulator capture, English/light.
findings.user_impact: The recruiter receives conflicting answers about whether the person exists and may manually recreate or verify the contact elsewhere. The same-operation retry protects the in-app path, but cannot make contradictory visible status trustworthy.
findings.recommendation: When the protected write remains pending, use one consistent message: “The save result is not confirmed. Check the original save.” Reserve “not saved” for a verified pre-write failure or definitive rejection. Keep the existing operation identity, locked fields and safe retry.
findings.verification: Repeat the existing response-loss/relaunch case. Before reconciliation, capture and assert that no visible or accessibility error says the contact was not saved; the screen consistently says the result is unknown. After retry, verify the original operation receipt and existing single destination identity. Also test a confirmed pre-write failure retains its accurate failure wording.

findings.criterion: Task legibility (2/4): identify a fork when resuming from Sessions
findings.observation: Confirmed visible retrieval ambiguity. Immediately after a fork and native back, both Sessions rows display “Create a review plan from this synthetic note.” and “Agent conversation”; only elapsed time and a generic Refresh needed state distinguish them. The transient “Session fork created. Continue here.” notice identifies the branch while inside it, but the list does not persist that meaning. Code stores originSessionID while copying the original title.
findings.evidence: Frozen GET-5-product-v1 at /tmp/get5-product-review-v1: evidence/screenshots/12-native-back-original-and-fork-r7.png, the two central Sessions rows; evidence/screenshots/13-fork-context-r7.png, notice above composer. source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipArchiveModels.swift:2655-2663 stores the origin and copies the title; source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipArchiveView.swift:3536-3551 and :3579-3611 renders title/context/time without origin. evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r7.log:652-676 confirms the edge-back and two-row state. Surface: supplied 1206×2622 portrait Simulator capture, English/light.
findings.user_impact: After interruption, a recruiter must infer which row is the exploratory continuation or reopen both. A refresh status describes source freshness and does not reliably communicate branch identity.
findings.recommendation: Use the existing originSessionID to add a small localized “Fork” label to the branch row and its accessibility label. Keep the source title intact; a full branch-management interface is unnecessary for this slice.
findings.verification: Fork once, navigate back, relaunch, and resume the branch from Sessions in English and Chinese at default and AX5 sizes. The branch remains explicitly identifiable in pixels and accessibility output while the original remains available; neither selection relies solely on recency or Refresh needed.

strengths: Information hierarchy (3/4): evidence/screenshots/04-markdown-structured-r6.png visibly separates the original prompt, answer headings, nested list, checked/unchecked items, table, code and no-save statement. evidence/screenshots/10-screenshot-inline-r6.png leads with the screenshot summary and “No action has been taken”; Sources and processing details is a secondary disclosure. This verifies presentation, not a completed production screenshot-to-follow-up journey.

Evidence/control (3/4): evidence/screenshots/07-contact-response-lost-r6.png keeps name, Finance context, exact email and Source message visible in the review card. The missing-relationship UI test explicitly asserts save is disabled and decline retains the original message (source/apps/ios/UITests/Get5SessionUITests.swift:129-148; evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r6.log:1220-1287). No seeded-error user success rate is claimed.

Platform interaction (3/4): the supplied r7 native test passed after pressing at the left edge and dragging back to Sessions (evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r7.log:652-676). Message controls are visually quiet in evidence/screenshots/05-message-controls-r6.png; the test checks actual accessible bounds of all four controls at 44×44 points, taps copy and toggles feedback twice (source/apps/ios/UITests/Get5SessionUITests.swift:35-59; r7 log:676). The frozen renderer also supplies contentShape and accessible names (source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipAskView.swift:7493-7544).

Platform interaction: evidence/screenshots/02-voice-draft.png shows editable transcribed words above the keyboard with a separate Send control. The deterministic native hold, ordinary tap and typed-text-preservation tests passed (evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r6.log:1012, :1060, :1330). This supports gesture ownership and draft-first behavior, not actual microphone quality or field transcription reliability.

State completeness (3/4): the interrupted screenshot capture explicitly tells the user to reattach the same images in the same order and says its message will not be sent as text (evidence/screenshots/06-screenshot-recovery-r6.png). The native test passed through termination/relaunch with composer disabled and recovery retained (source/apps/ios/UITests/Get5SessionUITests.swift:151-173; evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r6.log:1121). Ended proposals also disable edit/save while preserving source (r6 log:971).

Feedback/recovery supporting behavior: evidence/screenshots/08-contact-same-operation-restored-r6.png shows a Contact created receipt for Mina Patel and Open in People; evidence/screenshots/09-original-message-and-receipt-r6.png explicitly marks the restored receipt for Noor Vega as a reference to verify in People. The response-loss and canonical receipt restart cases passed (evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r6.log:552, :704). The wording defect above does not erase this recovery evidence.

Visual craft (3/4): the inspected light English captures use coherent graphite type, off-white fields, restrained separators and limited red; there is no visual person-ranking score. In evidence/screenshots/11-ax5-chinese-menu-r6.png, table header/value pairs stack vertically and the Chinese share/fork menu remains readable in dark mode. source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/AgentMarkdownView.swift:234-255 implements that vertical alternative, and r6 log:1187-1188 records Step/Source and State/Available semantics.
missing_evidence: Evidence scope: reviewed all 14 frozen screenshots, relevant frozen iOS implementation/tests and supplied executable logs. All 82 manifest SHA-256 entries were verified with zero mismatches. Review used evidence level 3 (screenshots plus implementation) supplemented by recorded test execution; this reviewer did not directly operate the executable build. Confidence is capped at supported_inference. Device model is not established by the frozen screenshots; the supplied log identifies Simulator destination 02B4F0C1-A92F-469D-9DCC-5ED13F119507. Intended task: an independent recruiter continues a mobile conversation through text/voice/screenshot, reviews a contact, saves, restarts and forks while preserving source and operation identity.

Accessibility (2/4): the frozen set does not demonstrate the full contact-review/save/recovery path on the smallest supported iPhone, with actual AX5 action reachability, VoiceOver traversal/activation, or denied/revoked microphone/photo permissions. No physical-device VoiceOver claim is warranted. Verify identity → source → editable fields → save → result in both locales, with actual accessible hit bounds and actions; code frames alone are insufficient. Root owns the ongoing SE3 and final screenshot proof.

AX5 capture completeness is missing proof, not an established clipping defect: evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r7.log:801 fails an artificial 124pt capture margin at 122pt, whereas r6 log:1219 passed the vertical table/reachability scenario. evidence/screenshots/11-ax5-chinese-menu-r6.png shows only part of the horizontally scrollable code line and an open menu; it cannot prove full code content access or the complete review flow. Capture against actual navigation/composer bounds and traverse the complete content before release approval.

The screenshot-to-source-detail-to-canonical-follow-up path remains unproven in this frozen native run. The inline-result screenshot demonstrates its visible state, while evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r7.log:389-391 records a startup-fixture selector failure. This is not evidence of a production upload defect. Final actual screenshot GLM trials, fixture capture and local TestFlight rebuild are still owned by root and must not be reported complete from this packet.

Performance feel (2/4): supplied fixture tests and static screenshots do not measure first acknowledgement, long-generation cancel response, scrolling jank or degraded-network latency. No field task-time benefit is established. Observe one slow-network screenshot/read/save interruption and record acknowledgement/cancel behavior; report measured values rather than treating test duration as interaction latency.

Whole-Session sharing has a visible menu entry and frozen implementation, but these captures/logs do not show opening the native share sheet and checking the exported conversation payload there. Real IME composition, full keyboard/switch access, increased contrast, localization expansion and oldest-supported-iOS behavior are also not demonstrated by this focused set.
